title: Slavomolisano
extract: Slavomolisano, also known as Molise Slavic or Molise Croatian, is a variety of Shtokavian Croatian spoken by Italian Croats in three villages – Montemitro, Acquaviva Collecroce and San Felice del Molise – in the province of Campobasso, in the Molise Region of southern Italy. There are fewer than 1,000 active speakers, and fewer than 2,000 passive speakers.
